claims.disproof_condition: 條件：Arbe 之後的 20-F、6-K 寫出 Hirain 的具約束力訂單取消、延後到 2027 以後，或 Hirain 改用別家晶片組。核查頻率：每季（Arbe 6-K 財報新聞稿）。觸發後 48 小時：降這條邊與 claim 的 confidence，ARBE 敘事重答「量」那一格。
claims.statement: Arbe FY2025 20-F: Arbe is a Tier-2 imaging radar chipset supplier to Tier 1s and OEMs, with chipsets manufactured and tested by GlobalFoundries; Hirain issued a preliminary order for 340,000 radar chipsets in Q4 2022 to secure capacity and has issued a binding purchase order for thousands of chipsets to be shipped in 2026 for the initial production ramp. Supplier self-report; the order sizes are not confirmed by Hirain in this filing.

claims.disproof_condition: 條件：客戶端或第三方一手文件寫出成像雷達晶片組只有一兩家合格、或某車廠或 robotaxi 平台指定單一來源。核查頻率：每半年（Hirain、NVIDIA、車廠公告）。觸發後 48 小時：重讀成像雷達晶片組層的供給側。
claims.statement: Arbe FY2025 20-F names competing radar chip suppliers: Texas Instruments and NXP offer 4Rx*4Tx radar transceivers and recently started sampling 8Rx*8Tx chips scalable to 24Rx*24Tx; NXP also offers a dedicated radar processing chip; Mobileye develops a 1,536-virtual-channel imaging radar. This is Arbe's own description of its competitors, not a third-party count of the layer's suppliers.

sources.locator: Item 4 Business — Tier-2 晶片組定位
sources.quote: In the private automobile market, we operate as a Tier-2 semiconductor company, developing advanced radar technology and solutions – multi-channel Radio Frequency Integrated Circuit (RF IC) for transmission and reception and a dedicated radar processing IC that includes specialized Radar Processing Unit (‘RPU’) and additional general-purpose processing/control cores. We do not have our own chipset manufacturing facilities. We rely on GlobalFoundries for manufacturing and testing our chipset.
As a Tier 2 supplier, we supply imaging radar chipset to Tier 1 manufacturers who are building imaging radar systems and to OEMs.

Hirain and Arbe signed a number of agreements regulating the development manufacturing of radar product(s) based on Arbe’s chipset. During the fourth quarter of 2022, Hirain issued a preliminary order for 340,000 radar chipsets in order to secure capacity for its anticipated production ramp-up. Hirain has issued a binding purchase order for thousands of chipsets to be shipped in 2026 to support the initial ramp to production.

Texas Instruments and NXP offer a radar transceiver of 4Rx * 4Tx, and recently started sampling 8Rx * 8Tx chips capable of scaling up to 24Rx * 24Tx. NXP also offers dedicated radar processing chip capable of processing up to 4 trancievers.
